timestamp_ns.description: Monotonic capture-clock timestamp for the first sample of this frame, in nanoseconds; not wall time.

frame_index.description: Zero-based input frame counter in the capture clock domain.

sample_rate_hz.description: Nominal capture sample rate in samples per second.

queue_depth.description: Frames waiting for processing at publication time; excludes the frame currently executing.

xrun_count.description: Cumulative driver-reported underflow plus overflow events since stream start.

dropped_samples.description: Cumulative discarded samples since stream start, summed across time rather than channels. null means at least one loss interval has unknown length; this remains unknown until a new explicit statistical epoch.

clipping_fraction.description: Fraction of scalar samples clipped in this frame across all channels.

sro_ppm.description: Estimated device sampling-rate offset relative to the designated reference clock, in ppm, over the configured estimator window.

rtf.description: Cumulative processing service time divided by newly advanced source audio duration in the measured interval. The producer declares that interval, advanced sample count and processing scope in its configuration or accompanying metadata. Waiting, end-to-end response and deadline misses are separate measurements; overlapping analysis windows do not enlarge the denominator.

frame_service_rtf.description: Optional single-frame processing service time divided by this frame's newly advanced source audio duration. It is distinct from cumulative rtf; its unweighted mean generally differs from rtf. A record validator checks its type/range, not the measured timing or aggregation.

vad_active.description: VAD output state for this frame after hysteresis and hangover.

deadline_miss.description: Whether this frame completed after its configured frame deadline.

agc_gain.description: Linear amplitude gain applied to this frame.

model_version.description: Stable identifier for the complete ordered model chain; use an application-defined compound identifier when several models run.

known_dropped_samples.description: Optional cumulative known portion of discarded samples in the same epoch. When dropped_samples is an integer this cannot exceed it; the application validator checks the relationship.
